note: lo nikhsaf may mean "not longing/not ashamed" (kasaf "grow pale, long for"); "not desired" (unloved) is one guess, "shameless" another.

kjv: both the cormorant and the bittern shall lodge in the upper lintels of it (Nineveh)
mine: even the owl and the hedgehog shall lodge in her (Nineveh's) capitals
note: qa'at and qippod are probably an owl and the hedgehog (or porcupine), creatures of ruins; cormorant (a sea bird) and bittern (a marsh bird) do not fit a dry ruined city.
